clips.text: Choral Society, Needleeraft Club, Boys’ Club, Anacostia Athletic Club.
Present accommodations in Anacostia afford rooms for only about 50 children the year around, t'nder the proposed building program.

Manager Quienten Trotter of Renroca at Lin coln 7268 wants to hear from the pilots of Friendship, Mereurys and National Preps after 5:30 p.m. Anacostia Eagles, who will work out tonight and Friday night at 7:30 o'clock at Fourteenth street and Good Hope road southeast, are after a game Sunday with a 110 pound team.

The parade will proceed north on Good Hope road to Nichols avenue, south on Nichols avenue to Pleasant street, east on Pleasant street to Val ley place, east on Valley place to fourteenth street, north or Four teenth street to Good …

W. G. Tomlinson of the naval air station at Anacostia, who miracuously escaped death a few hours previously, put the Curtiss (Hawk) standard Navy fighting ship through the tests, topping them off with several neat rolls, loops and spins.
… arc lights in Bogan Park and attracted hundreds of spectators, some of them coming from distant sections of the city to pay tribute to the enterprise of the Anacostia citizens.

note: Clips are machine-read text (OCR) from scanned Evening Star pages on the Library of Congress's Chronicling America, lightly cleaned (line-break hyphens rejoined, stray symbols removed); misspellings are the scanner's. Newspapers this old are public domain. Each clip links to its page at loc.gov. Clips that mention race, covenants, deed restrictions or slurs are skipped automatically (keyword list: race, races, racial, colored, coloured, negro, negroes, white only, whites only, for whites, white people, white persons, white residents, caucasian, segregation, segregated, covenant, covenants, restricted, restriction, restrictions, plus a list of slurs), because they need an editor's context; legal notices and lists of private individuals are skipped too.
